description: Optional per-server MCP version negotiation. Default stays the upstream "auto"; a plugin may opt into "legacy" for 2025-era stdio servers so the SDK does not spawn a server/discover sibling before the real process.

patches.after:
// DSHA_MCP_VERSION_NEGOTIATION_V1: opt-in legacy skips the stdio discover sibling; default unchanged.
			versionNegotiation: { mode: config.versionNegotiation === "legacy" ? "legacy" : "auto" },
